caption:
A prisoner turns into a crawling zombie.
Seedance 2.5 staged this whole prison nightmare.
prompt:
VIDEO PROMPT — 30 seconds. 16:9 landscape (1280x720). Ultra-photorealistic live-action Korean horror film: real skin texture, cold teal-grey prison grade lit by fluorescent ceiling tubes, later strobing red emergency light and total darkness, deep shadows, light film grain, 35mm lens with shallow depth of field for close-ups, 24mm for corridor wides. Camera feel: smooth slow dolly for the opening, then rough handheld shake for the attack, then rock-steady symmetrical wides and a locked-off final frame. Pacing: 10 seconds of slow-building creepy transformation, 9 seconds of explosive animal speed, then chaos and a silent, dark ending.

CHARACTERS:
- THE PRISONER: a young Korean woman, about 22, pale fair skin, delicate oval face, soft dark eyes, jaw-length glossy black bob, loose, with side-swept bangs. Bright orange short-sleeved prison shirt with a notched collar, red buttons and two small plain white rectangular patches on the chest; loose matching orange trousers; white sneakers. After the change (from 00:05): pupil-less MILKY-WHITE eyes, a web of grey-purple veins spreading over her cheeks, neck and upper chest, dark blood running from her lips down her chin. The same orange uniform in every shot.
- THE GUARD: a heavyset Korean man, about 40, round friendly face, small eyes, a big good-natured smile; dark navy correctional officer uniform with a zipped jacket, a gold shield emblem on the sleeve, a black peaked cap with a small gold badge.
- THE FEMALE OFFICER: a slim Korean woman, about 30, dark hair tied back, dark navy officer uniform and black boots, a ring of keys in her hand.
- OTHER PRISONERS: men and women in the same orange uniforms inside the cells on both sides.

LOCATION: a long, narrow, modern Korean prison corridor at night. Both walls are rows of dark teal-grey steel cell fronts with vertical bars, separated by square grey concrete pillars; a small green glowing lamp box on a pillar at waist height; polished grey-green concrete floor with soft reflections; flat fluorescent tube lights in a line along the ceiling; a heavy steel door with a small window at the far end.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:10.7) — The sweet smile turns. Starts medium-wide: the prisoner walks toward camera down the corridor on the left of frame, smiling and giving a playful little wave beside her face to the guard, who stands on the right next to the cell bars smiling back. Slow, smooth dolly back as she walks, so by 00:03 she is in a medium close-up at frame center and by 00:04 a close-up, the guard staying soft-focused behind her on the right, still smiling. 00:02 she glances down with a shy giggle. 00:03-00:04.5 she stops and smiles sweetly into the lens. 00:04.5 a thin dark vein cracks out under her left eye. 00:05 MUST SHOW: both eyes turn solid milky-white, the smile freezes. 00:06 dark blood spills from her lips down her chin and grey-purple veins spread over her face and neck; she glances sideways, then stares into the lens. 00:08 a wide, bloody grin. 00:08.5 her head tilts sideways to an unnatural, almost horizontal angle. 00:09-00:10 MUST SHOW: her head snaps back, mouth wide open, laughing hysterically at the ceiling, blood on her teeth and throat. 00:10.5 her head whips around toward the guard, who is still smiling, unaware.

SHOT 2 (00:10.7-00:14.7) — The lunge. Wide shot from behind her, handheld with hard shake. She spins and launches herself at the guard on the right, slamming him back against the cell bars with a metal clang; she pins him and lunges at his neck while he shoves at her head with one arm raised. 00:14 he buckles and drops; she drops low with him in a blur of motion.

SHOT 3 (00:14.7-00:17.8) — On all fours. Low, floor-level tracking shot from behind her. MUST SHOW: she is down on all fours like an animal, hands and white sneakers slapping the concrete, knees high, hips raised; the guard lies slumped on the floor against the bars on the right. She scuttles fast away from camera down the middle of the corridor; the camera follows low, then lets her pull ahead. The green lamp glows on the pillar at right.

SHOT 4 (00:17.8-00:19.5) — Alarm. The white lights cut out and red emergency light floods the corridor, pulsing between near-black red and dim teal. Low, symmetrical wide from behind as she keeps crawling on all fours down the center of the corridor toward the far steel door; orange-sleeved arms push out through the bars on both sides.

SHOT 5 (00:19.5-00:24.7) — On the ceiling. Symmetrical one-point wide shot at head height looking straight down the corridor to the steel door at the far end; the light strobes between red alarm light and cold white fluorescent light. Prisoners on both sides press against the bars, arms thrust through, screaming and banging the bars. MUST SHOW: the prisoner crawls UPSIDE DOWN across the ceiling like a spider, her orange uniform and black hair hanging down, moving from the upper left corner to the top center of frame, close to camera. 00:21.5 the far door opens and the female officer steps out; she runs toward camera down the corridor. 00:23 she drops her ring of keys, which clatter onto the floor, looks up at the ceiling, spins around and runs back to the open door at the end; the camera pushes in fast toward the doorway. 00:24.5 a ceiling tube flares bright and every light dies to black.

SHOT 6 (00:24.7-00:30.1) — Eyes in the dark. Locked-off, total black frame. MUST SHOW: two small glowing milky-white eyes, side by side in the upper center of frame, steady and unblinking. 00:27.5 a faint red backlight reveals a square glass window of the security booth around the eyes, the window about a third of the frame wide, centered. 00:28 MUST SHOW: a blood-covered hand rises from the lower left and presses flat against the glass, fingers spread wide, smearing streaks of blood, the white eyes still staring through the glass behind it. Hold to the end, no fade.

SOUND: no music, only a low ominous drone that grows. Shot 1: fluorescent hum, her soft footsteps and a light giggle; from 00:08 a shrill hysterical female laughter. Shot 2: a loud metal clang on the bars, the guard's choked shout, scuffling. Shot 3: fast slapping of hands and sneakers on concrete, the guard groaning. Shot 4: a wailing alarm siren starts. Shot 5: siren, prisoners screaming and banging bars, electrical buzzing as the lights flicker, the officer's running boots, keys clattering, her sharp gasp; an electric pop as the lights die. Shot 6: near silence, the drone, her hysterical laughter echoing far through the prison, a slow squeak of the hand sliding on the glass.
prompt_short: Photorealistic Korean prison horror, 16:9. A smiling prisoner in orange waves at a guard; her eyes turn milky-white, veins spread, blood drips. She laughs, attacks him, crawls on all fours and across the ceiling. Red alarms, blackout, white eyes, bloody hand on glass.
